Correct exactly 4 complete BigVitamin mascots, preserving cell order, each action, orientation, deliberate squash/stretch, rotation, paper motion and props. Correct inconsistent OUTLINE STYLE and BODY/EAR PROPORTIONS throughout this whole sheet.
Image2 is the exact whole clean0 mascot whose EYE SIZE the user selected. Preserve that open chocolate-brown eye diameter relative to the normal paper body, the same eye spacing and one small white highlight across all comparable open-eyed poses. Do not enlarge or shrink that approved relative eye size. Image2 also shows the desired tidy warm matte contour treatment; match its thin but clearly readable warm taupe-brown outer contour and restrained paper-fold lines. Thick dark play/ear outlines must become lighter and finer; overly faint recovery/flight outlines must remain clearly readable. Use the same contour weight relative to body width in every cell.
Images3 and4 are the ORIGINAL anatomy/expression authorities: a cream-white layered PAPER POMPOM fan mascot with exactly TWO attached bunny ears, orange square cheeks, yellow paper accents and no limbs. Keep one consistent normal paper-body volume, ear-root spacing, ear width and ear length. Correct accidental oversize/undersize body or ear proportions by comparing equivalent frontal poses with image2 and the original anatomy. Preserve physically intentional perspective, flopped ears, rolling, stretching and landing squashes; never flatten every action into a static front view.
Keep each expression emotionally correct: readable > < squeezed eyes and wink, sleeping arcs, teary eyes, dizzy spirals and strained WAVY recovery mouth, not a happy recovery smile. No face on back views. Preserve mouth placement within the face while redrawing its matching contour; eating alignment will be measured from the finished art. Preserve audience glow sticks only where already present. No arms, hands, legs, feet, fur, hat, extra ear or detached ear.
Keep complete silhouettes, generous transparent gutters, the same separate grid cells and empty outer border. Crisp clean warm matte cel illustration. Genuinely transparent background and retained alpha, no checkerboard, text, grid lines, scenery, halos, duplicate ghosts, extra scraps or cropped ears.
